_comment: Override for config/thresholds.json selecting the PEFRL integrator (SpecificDataPhysics::integrator): ./physics-qa test --thresholds config/integrators/pefrl.json. PEFRL is fourth order: on the default e=0.3 orbit its error reaches double round-off below 3600 s, so convergence_order uses an e=0.9 orbit (measured orders 4.00 / 4.00 / 4.00). PEFRL evaluates the forces four times per step, so its sub-steps go up to 4 x 7200 s = 28800 s (TimeStep::forForceEvaluations) and timestep_split_invariance uses that duration as its base update. Every other limit stays the one calibrated on Verlet.
